description: Voltage regulator for on-load tap-changers with the CIC communication card
source: Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen, "Voltage regulator TAPCON 240, Protocol description MODBUS", supplement 2398449/01 (2011-07), section 5

sources.title: Voltage regulator TAPCON 240, Protocol description MODBUS

notes: Modbus RTU or ASCII over RS-232, RS-485 or fibre. ASCII uses 7E1, RTU 8E1.
The optional RJ45 port carries Modbus RTU wrapped in TCP (factory port 1234, 19200 baud), not Modbus TCP.
Coils can only be written (FC05); their state cannot be read back. Write one coil or one register per request.
Commands from the control system are only executed when the regulator is in remote mode.
Coil 8 is either 'raise/lower desired voltage value' or 'desired voltage value 1', depending on how MR parameterised the device.
